description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Dispute between All Ceylon Commercial and Industrial Workers Union No 457 Colombo 08 and Other Part Sri Lanka Standards Institutions Colombo -08. - The Industrial Dispute between R.M.P.R.P. Rajapaksa Mirigama and Other Part Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation Colombo 05.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of legal/regulatory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains orders made by the Minister under Section 4(1) of the Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes, which constitutes regulatory action and legal procedures for dispute resolution. The content focuses on statutory instruments and legal processes rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
